_purpose: Internal verification record for the classical phrases in src/locales/*.json (keys phrase.*). Never imported by the app and never shown to users: the interface displays the phrase only, without speaker, narrator or source. See src/locales/catalogs.test.ts, which fails if a catalog contains attribution.
_method: Hadith wording and numbering from Sahih al-Bukhari / Sahih Muslim (standard numbering). Non-hadith reports located in the classical works named below via secondary references; a page check against a critical edition is still pending where noted. Quote sites and social media were used only to find candidates, never as evidence.

phrases.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 1975 (the Prophet to Abdullah ibn Amr): «فإنَّ لجسدك عليك حقًّا، وإنَّ لعينك عليك حقًّا…»
phrases.wordingNote: Faithful excerpt; the leading conjunction is dropped, no word altered.

phrases.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 1968 (Salman to Abu al-Darda', confirmed by the Prophet: «صدق سلمان»); Sunan Abi Dawud 1369 («…وإنَّ لنفسك عليك حقًّا»)
phrases.wordingNote: Faithful excerpt of «وإنَّ لنفسك عليك حقًّا», conjunction dropped.

phrases.source: Sahih Muslim 2750 (hadith of Hanzala: «…ولكن يا حنظلة ساعةً وساعة»)

phrases.text: الاشتغالُ بفواتِ وقتٍ ماضٍ تضييعُ وقتٍ ثانٍ.
phrases.source: al-Qushayri, al-Risala, section on the Sufi term «الوقت», introduced with «وقيل» (an anonymous saying reported by al-Qushayri, d. 465 AH)
phrases.wordingNote: The candidate «الاشتغال بوقت ماض تضييع وقت حاضر» was a paraphrase; the original wording is used. The full sentence is kept: dropping «الاشتغالُ» would misquote it.
phrases.status: approved; page check against a critical edition pending

phrases.text: إنّي لا يحلُّ لي أن أُضيِّعَ ساعةً من عمري.
phrases.source: Ibn Aqil al-Hanbali (d. 513 AH), recorded by Ibn al-Jawzi from Ibn Aqil's own handwriting; reproduced by Ibn Rajab, Dhayl Tabaqat al-Hanabila (entry on Ibn Aqil; secondary reference cites 3/121)
phrases.wordingNote: Opening clause, consistent across copies; the continuation varies slightly and is not used.
phrases.status: approved; page check against a critical edition pending

excluded.text: متى الراحة؟ قال: عند أول قدم أضعها في الجنة
excluded.reason: Reports (Tabaqat al-Hanabila, attributed to Imam Ahmad) read «يضعها», not «أضعها»; the meaning (no rest in this world) contradicts a break app and is strongly religious.
Conflicting attributions (Thabit ibn Qurra via al-Tha'alibi; Ali ibn Abi Talib) and varying wording; could not be established.
